Government Caps Prices for 39 New Medicines, Offering Relief to Patients

India's National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority (NPPA) has fixed the retail prices for 39 new medicines, including those for cancer, heart disease, and diabetes. This move aims to make essential drugs more affordable for patients across the country. The order, issued on July 8, sets maximum retail prices for a range of critical medications.
